learning_outcomes.text: Has principal knowledge about Math, Science and Engineering subjects related to their own branches.
Uses Math, Science and theoretical and practical knowledge of their own areas to find solutions for current engineering problems.
Identifies, formulates and solves engineering problems, for that purpose, selects and applies appropriate analytical methods and modeling techniques.
Analyzes a system, a component, or a process, designs under realistic constraints to meet the desired requirements implements the methods of modern design accordingly.
Selects and uses modern techniques and tools necessary for engineering applications.
Designs and performs experiments, collects data, analyzes and interprets the results. Finds solutions to problems in the fields of medicine and biology using engineering techniques.
Works effectively as an individual and multidisciplinary teams.
Collects information and does research of resources for this purpose, uses databases and other information resources.
Is aware of necessity of lifelong learning monitors developments in science and technology and continuously renews himself/herself.
Uses informatics and communication technology with computer software that is minimum required by the European Computer Driving Licence Advanced Level.
Communicates effectively verbal and written, uses at least one foreign language at B1 level of European Language Portfolio.
Is aware of universal and social effects of engineering solutions and applications, Is aware of entrepreneurship and innovation and has knowledge of contemporary issues.
